_meta.source: Teks asli heartodex (descriptionOriginal di file data) dengan salah ketik yang jelas dibetulkan. descriptionOriginal tetap apa adanya.
_meta.translatedNote: Teks sumber entri ini bukan bahasa Inggris; yang ditampilkan adalah terjemahan Inggris buatan AI yang belum ditinjau.

camouflage-bush: Once used, a bush appears that hides your presence from birds. Lasts 240 s.
bird-food: Obtained in exchange for delivering cards to Bailey J.
universal-animal-food: A food that provides balanced nutrition for all animals.
amazing-seasoning: Used for cooking. Improves the quality of the dish (at least 2 stars) when cooking succeeds (no effect on failure).
dog-food: Balanced kibble for dogs. Don't let your pup go hungry!
energy-dog-food: Feed your dog to restore its vitality.
cat-food: Nutritious food for cats. Don't let your cat go hungry!
drawing-board: Unleash your creativity on the drawing board.
energy-fish-jerky: Feed your kitty to restore its vitality.
auto-bird-whistle: Once used, nearby birds (except those on the stand) perform actions more often for 3 min.
